gates.title: wait_tasks(wait_any) always terminates
gates.invariant: No single tool call may wedge a turn: wait_any must return even for a meta-only task with no timeout supplied.
gates.oracle: waitMany(['<meta-only>'], 'wait_any') resolves in < 5s and reports the task as still running.

assertions: wait_any returns promptly for a meta-only task even with no timeout

gates.title: TypeScript compiles without errors
gates.invariant: The whole workspace type-checks; no new type error reaches main.
gates.oracle: `tsc --noEmit` exits 0 and prints zero error lines.

gates.title: Sandboxed spawns still execute the caller's command
gates.invariant: A background shell/monitor run under an active sandbox must execute the caller's own command, never a placeholder probe.
gates.oracle: sandboxWrapperArgv(command, decision) tail === command; 'true' appears nowhere in argv.

assertions: sandboxWrapperArgv > bakes the CALLER command into argv, not a probe command

gates.title: Builtin skill routing keeps its positive/negative triggers
gates.invariant: Positive triggers rank their target skill top-1; negative triggers stay below 0.15; no description collisions.
gates.oracle: router.eval.test.ts passes against the real product-content catalog (no LLM, deterministic).

assertions: positive triggers rank the target skill top-1
negative triggers stay well below positive-match strength
builtin skill descriptions do not collide

gates.title: Full unit suite is green
gates.invariant: `yarn test` must be a usable regression gate, not a wall of permanent red.
gates.oracle: `vitest run` exits 0 with zero failing tests.

knownGaps.reason: Environment-dependent expectations: macOS-only sandbox-exec assertions and ffmpeg-absent media tools. Being converted to self-skipping; until then this gate stays red on Windows.

gates.invariant: The Tauri host's pure logic stays green.
